welcome.title: Welcome to Moneytracker!
welcome.welcomeText: Regularly tracking our expenses helps us become more mindful in everyday life. It shows where the money leaks away, which habits support us, and which hold us back. When you see the real numbers, it's easier to make smart decisions: saving, planning, or confidently allowing yourself something. Financial transparency doesn't limit you — it gives you freedom, since you know exactly where you stand and where you want to go.
welcome.benefitsTitle: Why is it worth tracking our expenses?
welcome.liquidityTitle: It becomes clear where the money goes — no more "where did it all go?" moments.
welcome.easier: It's easier to spot unnecessary spending — you notice the hidden money-draining habits.
welcome.decisions: You make more mindful decisions — planning based on real data instead of gut feeling.
welcome.financial-stress: Financial stress decreases — fewer surprises, more control.
welcome.faster: You can save faster — you see where you can optimize smartly.
welcome.security: It gives security and freedom — you know exactly whether you can afford something.
welcome.goals: It helps you reach long-term goals — housing, travel, savings, whatever matters.
